تتقاضوا (form VI)
# تَتَقَاضَوْا (tataqāḍaw) /ta.ta.qaː.dˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
# تُتَقَاضَوْا (tutaqāḍaw) /tu.ta.qaː.dˤaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَقَاضَى (taqāḍā)
